pattern: において / における
purpose: Set a formal location, occasion, or field for a statement.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Noun + において + clause; noun + における + noun
The meeting will be held in the main building.
We consider the role of technology in education.
New facts emerged in this investigation.
formation: Noun + において + clause; noun + における + noun
restrictions: Common in announcements, research, and official descriptions.
mistake: Use における before a noun; ordinary conversation usually uses で.
